story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound Eligibility, Assessment, and Maintenance dates for transaction effective date logic
Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility span begins regardless of Assessment Date
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes
Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS004_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The same-day Assessment Date is applied as the transaction effective date, the six relevant field values remain unchanged, the inbound transaction is processed successfully, no rejection or absent-record condition is present in the validated evidence set, and the completed update is ready for audit evidence capture."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility starts when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: Status field contains "Negative" while scenario type is "Positive" and this test case is outside the stated condition: "Verify that the special future Eligibility Date transaction effective date rule is not applied when the inbound AR PASSE 834 changes a relevant field and also changes the Assessment Date, because this scenario is outside the stated condition."

Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS005_003" but no step has a Test Step Expected Result describing an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "No unexpected error row is created in CMC_MELC_LSTY_CD, and the Pregnancy change received one day before the span starts is stored with effective dating aligned to the tomorrow Eligibility Date, confirming the boundary case is fully processed and the Facets transaction effective date is populated correctly."

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date only for current eligibility relevant field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: Status field contains "Edge" for id "TC_TS006_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Quoted Expected Results are non-error/processing outcomes such as "The boundary test file is prepared with DTP*303 exactly matching the existing eligibility start date, making it a non-qualifying boundary condition for Maintenance Date usage.", "The file is processed successfully and policy unit delivery completes, allowing the non-qualifying boundary outcome to be verified in downstream data stores.", and "The count does not increase in a way that indicates an additional Maintenance Date split was created solely because DTP*303 equaled the eligibility start date."

scenarios.title: Regression validation that non-specified Maintenance Date usage does not impact downstream finance outcomes
gaps: Status field for id 'TC_TS007_003' is 'Edge' but no Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Quoted Expected Results include 'The pre-run query returns the current eligibility baseline, including the existing number of rows and effective-date boundaries for the member.', 'The file shows successful processing with completed policy unit delivery and no policy unit error.', and 'Zero exception rows are returned for the current run, no maintenance-date-driven span split is present, and the processed transaction effective date in Facets is correctly populated and validated for completed deployment.'
